name: Slayr
description: '''Evan McDonald,''' (born May 22, 2007), known professionally as '''Slayr''' (stylized in [[lowercase]]), is an American rapper, singer, and record producer from [[Philadelphia]]. He rose to fame in late 2025 following the release of his mixtape [[Half Blood (mixtape)|''Half Blood'']], and later followed through with its reissue ''[[BloodLuxe]]'', both of which received critical acclaim from media outlets for their execution, structure, and diversity of genres.
